market.question: Will the highest temperature in Los Angeles be between 64-65°F on May 5?

assessment.reasoning: LAX forecast for May 5 shows high near 71°F (sunny). Climatological average early May high at LAX is ~71-72°F. The 64-65°F bucket is 6-7°F below forecast — unlikely unless deep marine layer/onshore push. Probability for this narrow 2°F bucket far from forecast is low.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Marine layer intensity could push lower; data finalization rounding
